answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fakes with a sunk, unrecoverable cost. A jade carver pays a 15-unit tax; it buys no reputation. The identity must then do real jobs for clients across a mesa route, not its own copies. A lotus grower keeps standing by honest work, and receipts cannot transfer, so rented reputation cannot pass to a new fake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 15,000 units, above one reward; an honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
